description: PET hittekaart Provincie Zeeland is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dataportaal.zeeland.nl. At the beginning of 2019, the standardised calculation method for heat stress was established. This card is drawn up according to the standard. The heat stress map shows a sensory temperature, the Physiological Equivalent Temperature (PET) in the outdoor area. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "PET heat map Province of Zeeland" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Hitte, PET, Ruimtelijke Adaptatie, Klimaatadaptatie, Hittestress. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
